_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A message send that fails leaves its text saved for the conversation's composer. "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the send button" is [data-testid="send-button"]. Call "saved text" returns the text the server keeps for the conversation's composer, or "(none)". The server fails every message send; call "sends failed" counts them. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/composer-failed and wait (up to 30s) for the input to be visible.
2. Fill the input with "echo: failed send 4d1a" and, right away, press Enter in it.
3. Call "sends failed"; it should become "1" (up to 10s).
4. Call "saved text"; it should become "echo: failed send 4d1a" (up to 10s).
5. The input's value is exactly "echo: failed send 4d1a".
